note: Thresholds fixed a-priori from mechanism reasoning; no parameter search; changing any parameter requires a NEW hypothesis_id.
independence_policy: INDEPENDENT / DERIVED / REUSED must be declared; reuse of V1/V2 strategy logic/thresholds/prompts is forbidden (§9).

hypotheses.hypothesis: 1-minute 2.5-sigma mid move partially reverts over the next 5 minutes
hypotheses.mechanism: short-horizon liquidity absorption: a move far beyond recent realized vol is over-extended; makers replenish and price mean-reverts
hypotheses.invalid_condition: no reversion to the 1-sigma band within hold
hypotheses.evaluation_method: net bp per signal + blocked OOS

hypotheses.hypothesis: 1m close beyond the prior 20-bar range continues for 10 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: range breakout with a close beyond the extreme signals inventory imbalance / stop cascades that persist briefly
hypotheses.invalid_condition: close back inside the prior range within hold
hypotheses.evaluation_method: net bp per signal + blocked OOS

hypotheses.hypothesis: the first bar after 07:00 UTC continues in its own direction for 6 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: session-open order flow from European desk repositioning extends briefly before liquidity normalises
hypotheses.invalid_condition: immediate reversal beyond the opening bar range
hypotheses.evaluation_method: net bp per signal + blocked OOS

hypotheses.hypothesis: the sigma-fade works better when realized vol is in its lower tercile
hypotheses.mechanism: in quiet regimes the spread is tighter and the reversion impulse is less likely to be swamped by a trend leg
hypotheses.independence: DERIVED (regime-conditioning of H01's mechanism; independent test)

hypotheses.hypothesis: when the 1m mean spread z-score exceeds 2 the contemporaneous mid move fades
hypotheses.mechanism: spread widening marks transient liquidity withdrawal; the printed move is partly a liquidity artefact rather than information
hypotheses.evaluation_method: net bp per signal; spread cost dominant

hypotheses.hypothesis: in an EMA20>EMA50 uptrend a pullback to EMA20 then resumption continues 8 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: trend persistence plus short-term mean reversion interact: the pullback improves entry while the trend supplies drift

hypotheses.hypothesis: a failed test of a round 10.00 level fades away from the level for 6 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: round numbers concentrate resting liquidity; a failed test leaves trapped participants

hypotheses.hypothesis: after a bandwidth squeeze a breakout follows for 8 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: volatility compression precedes expansion; the direction of first expansion is informative over short horizons

hypotheses.hypothesis: the prior 30-minute move fades around the 21:00-22:00 UTC rollover
hypotheses.mechanism: daily rollover changes financing and dealer inventory, producing transient reversal without fresh information

hypotheses.hypothesis: an FXTM move aligned with an opposite DXY move reverses
hypotheses.mechanism: cross-asset disagreement indicates the local move is flow-driven rather than macro-driven and should revert

hypotheses.hypothesis: a tick-rate spike with a directional move fades 5 bars later
hypotheses.mechanism: tick-rate spikes are often quote churn rather than informed flow; the accompanying move is transient

hypotheses.hypothesis: an overnight gap from the prior session close partially fades at the open
hypotheses.mechanism: gaps that are not information-driven are liquidity vacuums that refill
